Open science

Many ideas and side-projects never see the light of day as a formal scientific publication. Nevertheless, they are functional and potentially useful. With such thoughts in mind, I here catalogue a set of open science computational products that I have created, promoting FAIR principles, scientific collaboration and the acceleration of scientific research.

  1. AnnotatoR: An R package for the creation of general purpose, IonReporter-compatible variant annotation files. Dionysios Fanidis (2026). DOI:10.5281/zenodo.21098337 BiobankCy/AnnotatoR

  2. ReporteR is a Shiny-powered application for the creation of comprehensive genetic diagnostic reports, starting from a small variant spreadsheet with minimum annotation data. Dionysios Fanidis (2026). DOI:10.5281/zenodo.21296883 BiobankCy/ReporteR
